t: You're looking at Our Ladye Star of the Sea, a Roman Catholic church on the west side of Croom's Hill, just west of Greenwich Park. Notice the landmark spire. The church is built in a Decorated Gothic style and is Grade II* listed. It opened in 1851. William Wardell designed it. He was an Australian architect, best known for landmark buildings in Melbourne and Sydney. The fittings and decoration were designed by Augustus Pugin and his son E. W. Pugin, so the details inside are worth a close look.
